skills.name: brainstorming
skills.when_to_use: Before any feature creation, component building, or behavior modification

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.purpose: Task breakdown into 2-5 minute chunks with complete code
skills.when_to_use: When you have a spec/requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.purpose: Red/green/refactor cycle — write failing test first, then implement, then refactor
skills.when_to_use: When implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.when_to_use: When executing implementation plans with independent tasks

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.purpose: Structured root cause analysis (4 phases: reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, fix)
skills.when_to_use: When encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.purpose: Run verification commands and confirm output before claiming work is complete
skills.when_to_use: Before committing, creating PRs, or claiming work is done

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.purpose: Execute written plans with batch execution and review checkpoints
skills.when_to_use: When you have a written implementation plan to execute

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.purpose: Submit code for review before merging
skills.when_to_use: When completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.purpose: Act on review feedback with technical rigor
skills.when_to_use: When receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions

skills.name: audit-observability
skills.purpose: State contract audit trail, orchestration observability, score analytics, and cross-service consistency enforcement
skills.when_to_use: Before and after every state transition, during scoring analysis, and when detecting drift across services

skills.name: adaptive-solver
skills.purpose: Meta-cognitive uncertainty resolution — structured loop for ambiguity, low confidence, or failed attempts. Agents detect the gap, inventory skills, hypothesize, attempt, evaluate, and retry without asking the user.
skills.when_to_use: When encountering ambiguous input, flagging confidence (≤ 3/5), or when a tool/skill attempt produced unexpected results. Trigger before guessing or asking the user for clarification.
